name: Agourontomatosalata
instructions: Peel tomatoes and cut into wedges , wash cucumber and core skin with the tines of fork and cut into thin slices
Slice onion using some of the green tops , and then combine all the veggies with the oregano in a salad bowl
Mix together olive oil , lemon juice , salt and pepper , taste and adjust
Pour dressing over salad and gently toss to mix
Serve right away or let the salad and dressing mingle awhile - i like mine to sit for 15 minutes or so
